aviation_incidents.headline: 易捷航空A321neo飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速並轉降
aviation_incidents.summary: 易捷航空A321neo於2026年11月26日飛行兩分鐘後發生引擎失速並轉降；該機仍停在愛丁堡，航班延誤六小時，易捷航空已派備用機接送乘客前往目的地。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: easyJet Airbus A321neo diverts after an engine stall two minutes into flight
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An easyJet Airbus A321neo suffered an engine stall two minutes into its flight on November 26, 2026, and diverted. The aircraft remained on the ground in Edinburgh; the flight was delayed six hours, and easyJet dispatched a spare jet to take passengers to their destination.

aviation_incidents.headline: 六起獨立航空事件涉及樹木接觸、兩起跑道事件、引擎問題與雷擊
aviation_incidents.summary: 2026年11月25日至27日的六起航空事件各自獨立：FAST Congo的L410於27日在Dilolo進場時接觸樹木；Fedex的MD-11於25日在邁阿密降落時衝出跑道；Delta的空中巴士A321於26日在亞特蘭大發生引擎故障；Western Global的波音747-400於25日在東京回滑時偏出跑道；France的波音777-300於25日在巴黎附近出現引擎電子控制問題；THY的波音737-800於25日在Batumi遭遇多次雷擊。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Six independent aviation incidents involve tree contact, two runway events, engine problems and lightning
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Six independent incidents occurred from November 25 to 27, 2026, with no relationship stated: FAST Congo’s L410 contacted trees on approach at Dilolo on November 27; Fedex’s MD-11 overran the runway on landing at Miami on November 25; Delta’s Airbus A321 had an engine failure at Atlanta on November 26; Western Global’s Boeing 747-400 veered off the runway while backtracking at Tokyo on November 25; France’s Boeing 777-300 had an engine electronic-control problem near Paris on November 25; and THY’s Boeing 737-800 experienced multiple lightning strikes at Batumi on November 25.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空計畫現金增資發行3億股 募資主要用於償還銀行借款
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空公告現金增資，預計以每股新臺幣15.5元發行3億股，按發行價估計募資約新臺幣46.5億元，主要用於償還銀行借款。員工認購3,000萬股、原股東依認股基準日持股比例認購約2.4億股，另3,000萬股公開承銷，分別占10%、80%及10%。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux Airlines plans a 300 million-share cash capital increase mainly to repay bank loans
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines plans a cash capital increase of 300 million shares at NT$15.5 each, expected to raise about NT$4.65 billion at that price, mainly to repay bank loans. The proposed allocation is 30 million shares for employees, about 240 million for existing shareholders in proportion to holdings on the subscription record date, and 30 million for public underwriting, representing 10%, 80% and 10% respectively.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic申請破產並暫停所有航班 復飛時間尚未公布
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic已申請破產並暫停所有航班，復飛時間尚未公布。巴基斯坦國際航空（PIA）先前以Norse Atlantic的波音787-9營運英國航線；雙方10月簽署涵蓋兩架Dreamliner的濕租協議。PIA表示自11月26日起改用自有波音777營運所有英國航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy and suspends all flights with no resumption date announced
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic filed for bankruptcy and suspended all flights, with no resumption date announced. Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) had been using Norse Atlantic Boeing 787-9s on UK services; the airlines signed an October wet-lease agreement covering two Dreamliners. PIA said it would operate all UK flights with its own Boeing 777s from November 26.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司申請破產
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司Norse Atlantic Airways AS於2026年11月27日宣布已申請破產，原因是未能籌得足以履行短期財務義務的資金。破產程序已向挪威Agder District Court提出，迄今尚未影響上市母公司或英國子公司；Norse Atlantic Airways同週稍早已執行最後航班，並停飛全數機隊。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian operating subsidiary files for bankruptcy
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian operating subsidiary, Norse Atlantic Airways AS, announced on November 27, 2026, that it had filed for bankruptcy because it could not secure enough funds to meet its short-term financial obligations. The proceedings were filed at Norway’s Agder District Court and had so far not affected the listed parent company or its UK subsidiary. Norse Atlantic Airways had operated its final flights earlier that week and grounded its entire fleet.
